title: Kapan tanggal jatuh tempo angsuran saya?
content: Tanggal jatuh tempo tercantum di kontrak pembiayaan dan di aplikasi Pundi Mitra. Angsuran (cicilan) dibayar setiap bulan sesuai tenor yang dipilih, misalnya tenor 12, 24 atau 36 bulan.

source.doc_title: Pundi Mitra Finance – FAQ Pembayaran Angsuran
source.section: Kapan tanggal jatuh tempo angsuran saya?

title: Berapa denda keterlambatan?
content: Jika angsuran belum dibayar setelah tanggal jatuh tempo, dikenakan denda keterlambatan sebesar 0,2% per hari dari angsuran yang tertunggak. Tidak ada masa tenggang untuk denda. Keterlambatan juga dilaporkan ke SLIK OJK dan dapat memengaruhi riwayat kredit.

source.doc_title: Pundi Mitra Finance – FAQ Pembayaran Angsuran

title: Bagaimana cara membayar angsuran?
content: Virtual account BCA, BRI, Mandiri atau BNI (nomor VA = kode perusahaan + nomor kontrak) Gerai Indomaret dan Alfamart (sebutkan "bayar angsuran Pundi Mitra" dan nomor kontrak), biaya admin Rp2.500–Rp5.000 Aplikasi Pundi Mitra, Tokopedia atau DANA Pembayaran melalui virtual account masuk secara real-time. Simpan bukti pembayaran.

source.doc_title: Pundi Mitra Finance – FAQ Pembayaran Angsuran

title: Apakah saya bisa membayar sebagian angsuran?
content: Bisa, tetapi sisa angsuran tetap dianggap tertunggak dan dikenakan denda. Disarankan membayar penuh sebelum jatuh tempo.

source.doc_title: Pundi Mitra Finance – FAQ Pembayaran Angsuran
source.section: Apakah saya bisa membayar sebagian angsuran?

title: Saya kesulitan membayar. Apa pilihannya?
content: Hubungi kami sebelum jatuh tempo. Tim Customer Care dapat meninjau pengajuan restrukturisasi, misalnya perpanjangan tenor atau penjadwalan ulang, sesuai ketentuan perusahaan dan POJK. Pengajuan tidak otomatis disetujui.

source.doc_title: Pundi Mitra Finance – FAQ Pembayaran Angsuran

title: Bagaimana dengan BPKB kendaraan saya?
content: Untuk pembiayaan motor, BPKB disimpan oleh Pundi Mitra sebagai jaminan dan dapat diambil di kantor cabang paling lambat 14 hari kerja setelah pelunasan.

source.doc_title: Pundi Mitra Finance – FAQ Pembayaran Angsuran

title: Apakah saya bisa melunasi lebih cepat?
content: Bisa. Pelunasan dipercepat dikenakan biaya penalti 3% dari sisa pokok pembiayaan. Minta surat simulasi pelunasan melalui aplikasi atau cabang.

source.doc_title: Pundi Mitra Finance – FAQ Pembayaran Angsuran
source.section: Apakah saya bisa melunasi lebih cepat?

title: Uang muka (DP)
content: DP minimal untuk pembiayaan motor baru adalah 10% dari harga OTR sesuai ketentuan OJK, dan untuk elektronik minimal 0% sampai 20% tergantung program.

source.doc_title: Pundi Mitra Finance – FAQ Pembayaran Angsuran

title: Aturan: Jam menghubungi dan etika
content: Konsumen hanya boleh dihubungi pukul 08.00–20.00 waktu setempat (WIB/WITA/WIT), sesuai ketentuan perlindungan konsumen OJK. Sebutkan nama, perusahaan, tujuan telepon, dan bahwa percakapan direkam. Gunakan sapaan "Bapak/Ibu", bahasa sopan, tidak mengancam, dan tidak menghubungi kontak darurat untuk membahas utang.

source.doc_title: Pundi Mitra Finance – Panduan Telepon Pengingat Angsuran

title: Aturan: Verifikasi
content: Sebelum menyebut jumlah angsuran, verifikasi konsumen dengan tanggal lahir atau 4 digit terakhir nomor kontrak. Jangan memberikan informasi kontrak kepada pihak lain.

source.doc_title: Pundi Mitra Finance – Panduan Telepon Pengingat Angsuran

title: Keberatan: "Belum gajian, Pak/Bu"
content: Tunjukkan empati. Tanyakan kapan konsumen bisa membayar. Ingatkan bahwa denda 0,2% per hari berlaku sejak lewat jatuh tempo. Jika konsumen menyanggupi tanggal tertentu, catat janji bayar. Jika lebih dari 7 hari setelah jatuh tempo, tawarkan telepon balik dari tim Customer Care untuk membahas opsi.

source.doc_title: Pundi Mitra Finance – Panduan Telepon Pengingat Angsuran

title: Keberatan: "Minta keringanan / hapus denda"
content: Petugas pengingat tidak dapat menghapus atau mengurangi denda. Pengajuan keringanan diproses oleh tim Customer Care dalam 5 hari kerja. Jangan menjanjikan hasil.

source.doc_title: Pundi Mitra Finance – Panduan Telepon Pengingat Angsuran

title: Keberatan: "Motornya sudah dijual / dioper ke orang lain"
content: Jelaskan dengan sopan bahwa pengalihan kendaraan tanpa persetujuan tertulis tidak diperbolehkan dan kewajiban angsuran tetap pada konsumen. Eskalasi ke supervisor; jangan berdebat.

source.doc_title: Pundi Mitra Finance – Panduan Telepon Pengingat Angsuran

title: Keberatan: "Ini penipuan ya?"
content: Pundi Mitra tidak pernah meminta OTP, PIN atau transfer ke rekening pribadi. Konsumen dapat memverifikasi melalui Call Center 1500-123 atau aplikasi Pundi Mitra.

source.doc_title: Pundi Mitra Finance – Panduan Telepon Pengingat Angsuran

title: Aturan: Eskalasi
content: Jika konsumen meminta berbicara dengan petugas, mengajukan keluhan, atau melaporkan musibah, buat jadwal telepon balik maksimal 1 hari kerja atau sambungkan ke petugas.

source.doc_title: Pundi Mitra Finance – Panduan Telepon Pengingat Angsuran

title: Objection: "Why are you calling me before the due date?"
content: Thank the customer for their repayment track record. Explain that this is a courtesy reminder so that the instalment is not missed and a bounce charge of ₹590 (incl. GST) plus their own bank's charges are avoided. Offer to skip further reminders by confirming auto-debit balance.

source.doc_title: Objection Handling Playbook – Pre-Due Reminder Calls
source.section: Objection: "Why are you calling me before the due date?"

title: Objection: "I don't have money right now / salary is late"
content: Acknowledge the situation. Ask when the customer expects funds. If the expected date is within the grace period of 3 days after the due date, record a promise to pay. If later, explain that late payment charges and credit bureau reporting may apply and offer a callback from the Customer Assistance team.

source.doc_title: Objection Handling Playbook – Pre-Due Reminder Calls
source.section: Objection: "I don't have money right now / salary is late"

title: Objection: "I already paid"
content: Thank the customer. Ask for the payment date, mode and UTR / receipt number. Explain that payments can take up to 2 working days to reflect and raise a payment trace request. Never argue with the customer.

source.doc_title: Objection Handling Playbook – Pre-Due Reminder Calls

title: Objection: "Waive my late fee / bounce charge"
content: Explain politely that reminder agents cannot waive or reduce charges. The request can be reviewed by the Customer Assistance team within 5 working days. Do not promise an outcome.

source.doc_title: Objection Handling Playbook – Pre-Due Reminder Calls
source.section: Objection: "Waive my late fee / bounce charge"

title: Objection: "Stop calling me"
content: Apologise for the inconvenience. Explain that this is a one-time pre-due reminder. Offer to set up auto-debit (NACH) so manual reminders are not needed. Respect a request not to be called again during the current cycle and record it.

source.doc_title: Objection Handling Playbook – Pre-Due Reminder Calls

title: Objection: "Is this call a fraud? How do I know you are from Udaan?"
content: Never ask for OTP, PIN or card details. Tell the customer they can verify by calling the toll-free number 1800-000-1234 or by checking the loan details in the Udaan app. Offer to end the call and let them pay through the app.

source.doc_title: Objection Handling Playbook – Pre-Due Reminder Calls

title: Objection: "I want to close my loan instead"
content: Share that personal loans can be foreclosed after 6 EMIs and foreclosure charges apply as per the schedule of charges. Offer to request a foreclosure statement through the app or customer care.

content: Use this form to request a change of your monthly EMI due date. Requests must reach us at least 10 days before the next due date. Only one change is allowed during the loan tenure. Fields required: Loan Account No.; Name of Borrower (as per records); Registered Mobile No.; Current EMI Date (options: 2nd, 5th, 10th, 15th); Requested EMI Date (options: 2nd, 5th, 10th, 15th); Reason for change; I agree that broken-period interest will be added to my next EMI..

title: Nach / E-Mandate Registration Form

Registration takes 7-10 working days; pay the first EMI manually if the mandate is not active by then. To cancel or change the bank account for auto-debit, submit a new mandate at least 15 days before the next due date. Fields required: Name of Account Holder; Bank Name; Account No.; IFSC; Account Type (options: Savings, Current); Max Debit Amount (Rs.); Frequency (options: Monthly); Start Date (DD/MM/YYYY); End Date (options: Until cancelled); Loan Account No.; Mobile No.; Signature of Account Holder(s).

title: Calling hours
content: Customers may be contacted only between 8:00 AM and 7:00 PM local time, unless the customer has explicitly requested a call outside these hours.

source.doc_title: Fair Practices Code - Reminder and Collection Calls

title: Identification and disclosure
content: Every call must start with the caller's name, the company name (Udaan Credit Finance), the purpose of the call, and a disclosure that the call is recorded for quality and compliance purposes.

source.doc_title: Fair Practices Code - Reminder and Collection Calls

title: Identity verification and privacy
content: Loan details (EMI amount, due date, outstanding) may be shared only after verifying the customer with at least one identifier: date of birth or last 4 digits of the loan account. Loan details must never be disclosed to a third party, family member or colleague. If the person answering is not the customer, end the call politely without details.

source.doc_title: Fair Practices Code - Reminder and Collection Calls

title: Conduct
content: Agents must not use threatening, abusive or misleading language, must not threaten legal action that is not initiated, and must not contact the customer's references or employer about the loan. Agents must not ask for OTP, PIN, CVV or passwords.

source.doc_title: Fair Practices Code - Reminder and Collection Calls

title: Escalation
content: If the customer requests a human, disputes the loan, raises a complaint, or reports hardship, the call must be transferred or a callback created within 1 working day.

source.doc_title: Fair Practices Code - Reminder and Collection Calls

title: Scope
content: This schedule applies to all Personal Loans, Business Loans and Two-Wheeler Loans disbursed or serviced by Udaan Credit Finance Ltd. from 01-Apr-2026. It supersedes Version 2.1 dated 15-Jan-2025.

source.doc_title: Schedule of Charges and Repayment Policy

title: Repayment and due date
content: EMIs are payable monthly on the due date recorded in the loan agreement. A grace period of 3 calendar days after the due date is allowed before late payment charges. If the due date falls on a bank holiday, NACH presentation happens on the next working day and no late charge is levied for that delay.

source.doc_title: Schedule of Charges and Repayment Policy

title: Charges
content: Late payment charge: 2% per month on the overdue EMI, calculated daily. Bounce / dishonour charge (NACH, cheque, e-mandate): ₹590 per instance, GST inclusive. Duplicate statement: ₹200 + GST. Duplicate NOC: ₹500 + GST. EMI date change: ₹0 (first request); not permitted more than once per tenure. Foreclosure (fixed rate, after 6 EMIs): 4% of principal outstanding + GST. Foreclosure (floating rate, individual borrowers): Nil.

source.doc_title: Schedule of Charges and Repayment Policy

title: Promise to pay (PTP) rules for reminder calls
content: A customer may commit to pay on any date up to the end of the grace period without approval. A commitment beyond the grace period must be recorded as 'PTP - beyond grace', the customer must be informed that late payment charges and bureau reporting may apply, and the case is flagged for the Customer Assistance team. Reminder agents must not waive, reduce or promise reversal of any charge. Waiver requests are reviewed only by the Customer Assistance team within 5 working days.

source.doc_title: Schedule of Charges and Repayment Policy
source.section: Promise to pay (PTP) rules for reminder calls

title: Hardship and restructuring
content: Customers reporting job loss, medical emergency, business disruption or natural calamity may be offered a review by the Customer Assistance team. Options include a one-time EMI date shift, a payment plan for overdue amounts of up to 3 instalments, or tenure restructuring. No option is guaranteed until approved.

source.doc_title: Schedule of Charges and Repayment Policy

title: Payment in cash
content: Cash is accepted only at branches or by authorised collection staff carrying an Udaan ID card and issuing an instant e-receipt. Customers must not pay cash to anyone else.

title: Customer care
content: Call our toll-free number 1800-000-1234 between 9 AM and 7 PM, Monday to Saturday, or email care@udaancredit.example. Our virtual assistant on the app is available 24x7 for payments and statements.

title: Grievance redressal
content: If your complaint is not resolved within 7 working days, write to the Grievance Redressal Officer at grievance@udaancredit.example. If it is not resolved within 30 days, you may approach the RBI Ombudsman through the RBI Complaint Management System (cms.rbi.org.in).

title: Report fraud
content: Udaan never asks for your OTP, UPI PIN, CVV or passwords over phone, SMS or email. Report suspicious calls to fraud@udaancredit.example.

title: What happens if I miss my EMI due date?
content: If the EMI is not received within the grace period, a late payment charge of 2% per month on the overdue EMI amount is levied, along with a bounce charge of ₹590 (inclusive of GST) if an auto-debit or cheque fails. Missed payments are reported to credit bureaus such as CIBIL and may lower your credit score.

source.section: What happens if I miss my EMI due date?

title: Will a late payment affect my CIBIL score?
content: Yes. Udaan reports repayment status to all four credit bureaus every month. A payment delayed beyond the due date can be reported as overdue (DPD) and may reduce your credit score. Paying within the grace period avoids late charges, but the bureau status depends on whether the EMI was paid before the reporting date.

source.section: Will a late payment affect my CIBIL score?

title: Can I change my EMI due date?
content: Yes, once during the loan tenure. Submit the EMI Date Change Request form at least 10 days before the next due date. Available dates are the 2nd, 5th, 10th and 15th. Broken-period interest for the extra days is added to the next EMI.

source.section: Can I change my EMI due date?

title: I have already paid but still received a reminder. What should I do?
content: Payments can take up to 2 working days to reflect. If you paid through UPI, net banking or branch, keep your UTR or receipt number ready and share it with us. We will trace the payment and update your account. You will not be charged a late fee for a payment that was made on or before the due date.

source.section: I have already paid but still received a reminder. What should I do?

title: Can I pay part of my EMI?
content: Part payment of an EMI is accepted but the unpaid balance remains overdue and attracts late payment charges. We recommend paying the full EMI before the due date.

source.section: Can I pay part of my EMI?

title: I am facing financial difficulty. What are my options?
content: Please tell us early. Depending on eligibility, our Customer Assistance team can offer a one-time EMI date shift, a short payment plan for the overdue amount, or tenure restructuring as per our board-approved policy. These are reviewed case by case by a specialist and are not guaranteed.

source.section: I am facing financial difficulty. What are my options?

title: Can I foreclose or prepay my loan?

title: Loans that move with you
content: Udaan Credit Finance Ltd. is a Reserve Bank of India registered NBFC serving salaried and self-employed customers across 140 cities.

title: Personal Loan
content: Unsecured personal loans from ₹50,000 to ₹10 lakh for tenures of 12 to 60 months. Interest rates from 13.5% per annum (reducing balance). Processing fee up to 2.5% of the loan amount plus GST.

title: Business Loan
content: Working-capital and term loans for proprietors and MSMEs from ₹2 lakh to ₹50 lakh, tenure 12 to 48 months, interest from 16% per annum Minimum business vintage of 2 years is required.

title: Two-Wheeler Loan
content: Up to 95% on-road funding for two-wheelers, tenure 12 to 36 months, interest from 11.99% per annum

title: Why customers choose us
content: Disbursal in 48 hours* Pay EMIs by UPI, auto-debit, net banking or at any branch 4.6 star rating from 2 lakh+ customers *Subject to document verification and credit approval.

title: Festive Offer!!!
content: Zero processing fee on two-wheeler loans this Diwali. Apply now!

title: Branch Partnership Benefits
content: Operational, marketing, and technology support is provided to branch partners. Partners receive a co-branded outlet kit, access to the Udaan partner CRM, a dedicated relationship manager and monthly payout on disbursed volumes.

title: Who can apply
content: Existing DSA agencies, insurance POSPs and retail finance outlets with at least 2 years of operating history, a registered GST number and a clean credit record of the proprietor.

title: Payout structure
content: Payout is 1.0% to 1.75% of disbursed loan amount depending on monthly volume slabs, credited by the 10th of the following month.

title: Ways to pay your EMI
content: Your Equated Monthly Instalment (EMI) is due on the due date shown in your loan agreement and the Udaan app. Most customers have EMIs due on the 5th of every month.

title: Auto-debit (NACH / e-mandate)
content: If you registered a NACH mandate, your EMI is debited automatically from your bank account on the due date. Please keep sufficient balance in the account one day before the due date. If the debit fails, a bounce charge applies and the amount must be paid through any other mode.

title: Upi
content: Pay through the Udaan app or any UPI app using the UPI ID udaanemi@exampleupi. Enter your 12-digit loan account number in the remarks. UPI payments are credited the same day.

title: Net banking / Debit card
content: Log in to the customer portal and choose Pay EMI. Payments made after 8 PM are credited the next working day.

title: Branch cash or cheque
content: Visit any Udaan branch between 10 AM and 4 PM on working days. Cash payments above ₹49,999 require a PAN card. Always collect a computer-generated receipt. Udaan does not authorise field staff to collect cash without issuing a receipt.

title: Payment confirmation
content: You will receive an SMS and email confirmation within 2 hours of a successful payment. If you paid but did not receive confirmation within 48 hours, share the UTR/transaction reference with customer care so we can trace the payment.

title: Grace period
content: A grace period of 3 days after the due date is available before late payment charges are levied.

title: Rule: Calling hours and disclosure
content: Tumawag lamang mula 8:00 AM hanggang 8:00 PM (Philippine time), Monday to Saturday. Sabihin ang pangalan, na taga-Bituin Life kayo, ang purpose ng tawag, at na naka-record ang tawag. Gumamit ng "po" at "opo" at tawagin ang customer bilang Sir o Ma'am.

title: Objection: "Sabi ng bank, parang savings daw ito"
content: Linawin nang tapat: ang policy ay insurance na issued ng Bituin Life. Kung VUL ito, may investment component na hindi guaranteed ang returns. Hindi ito bank deposit at hindi PDIC insured. I-offer ang callback mula sa licensed financial advisor kung may reklamo sa pagkakabenta.

source.doc_title: Bituin Life – Premium Reminder Call Guide (Objections & Rules)
source.section: Objection: "Sabi ng bank, parang savings daw ito"

title: Objection: "Scam ba ito?"
content: Hindi kailanman hihingi ang Bituin Life ng OTP o PIN. Puwedeng i-verify ng customer sa hotline (02) 8000-1234 o sa Bituin Life app.

source.doc_title: Bituin Life – Premium Reminder Call Guide (Objections & Rules)

title: Rule: Escalation
content: Kapag humingi ng tao, may reklamo, o may death/claim concern, i-transfer o mag-schedule ng callback sa loob ng 1 business day. Huwag mag-promise ng approval ng claim o reinstatement.

source.doc_title: Bituin Life – Premium Reminder Call Guide (Objections & Rules)

title: Kailan due ang premium ko?
content: Ang premium due date ay nakalagay sa inyong Policy Data Page at sa Bituin Life app. Puwede kayong magbayad monthly, quarterly, semi-annual o annual depende sa napili ninyong payment mode.

source.doc_title: Bituin Life Assurance – Policyowner FAQ (Premium Payments)

title: Ano ang grace period?
content: May grace period po na 31 days mula sa due date. Habang nasa grace period, active pa rin ang coverage ng policy. Kapag hindi nabayaran ang premium pagkatapos ng 31 days, puwedeng mag-lapse ang policy maliban kung may sapat na cash value para sa Automatic Premium Loan (APL).

source.doc_title: Bituin Life Assurance – Policyowner FAQ (Premium Payments)

title: Paano magbayad ng premium?
content: Auto-debit mula sa inyong BancoBayan savings o credit card (recommended para hindi makalimutan) GCash o Maya (Pay Bills > Insurance > Bituin Life), ilagay ang 10-digit policy number Over-the-counter sa kahit anong BancoBayan branch Bayad Center at 7-Eleven CLiQQ (may convenience fee na ₱15 to ₱25) Ang online payments ay nag-reflect within 1 to 2 banking days. Laging i-keep ang reference number.

source.doc_title: Bituin Life Assurance – Policyowner FAQ (Premium Payments)

title: Ano ang mangyayari kapag nag-lapse ang policy?
content: Kapag lapsed na, wala nang coverage — hindi na mababayaran ang death o rider benefits. Puwedeng i-reinstate ang policy within 3 years mula sa lapse date kung babayaran ang lahat ng unpaid premiums with interest at magsusumite ng evidence of insurability (health declaration, minsan medical exam).

source.doc_title: Bituin Life Assurance – Policyowner FAQ (Premium Payments)
source.section: Ano ang mangyayari kapag nag-lapse ang policy?

title: Ano ang Automatic Premium Loan (APL)?
content: Para sa traditional policies na may cash value, kung hindi nabayaran ang premium pagkatapos ng grace period, automatic na kukunin ang premium sa cash value bilang loan para hindi mag-lapse ang policy. May interest ang APL na 8% per year at ibabawas ito sa benefits kung hindi mabayaran.

source.doc_title: Bituin Life Assurance – Policyowner FAQ (Premium Payments)

title: Puwede bang magpalit ng beneficiary?
content: Oo. Kung revocable ang beneficiary designation, mag-fill out ng Change of Beneficiary form sa app o sa branch. Kung irrevocable, kailangan ng written consent ng irrevocable beneficiary.

source.doc_title: Bituin Life Assurance – Policyowner FAQ (Premium Payments)

title: Ano ang riders?
content: Ang riders ay dagdag na benefits na naka-attach sa base policy, gaya ng Critical Illness rider, Accidental Death rider at Waiver of Premium rider. Kapag nag-lapse ang base policy, lapsed din ang riders.

source.doc_title: Bituin Life Assurance – Policyowner FAQ (Premium Payments)

title: Bank referral / bancassurance
content: Ang Bituin Life policies ay inaalok din sa BancoBayan branches sa pamamagitan ng bank referral. Ang bank staff ay licensed na Bancassurance Sales Associate; ang policy ay issued ng Bituin Life, hindi ng bangko, at hindi ito deposit na insured ng PDIC.

source.doc_title: Bituin Life Assurance – Policyowner FAQ (Premium Payments)
